Find the equation of the tangent plane to the surface defined by the equations x=u2,y=v2,z=uv,u≥0,v≥0, at the point (1,4,2).

a
4x+y−4z=0
b
x+y−z=−2
c
x−y+z=4
d
2x+2y−3z=0
e
2x−y+z=2
